title: REPORT on the Council position on Draft amending budget No 3/2026 of the European Union for the financial year 2026 – Adjustments in expenditure, update of revenues and other technical updates
part_text: 3. Stresses that the Union budget must be financed transparently and within the limits of the Own Resources Decision agreed unanimously by the Member States; rejects the introduction of new Union taxes or levies, including a digital levy, a levy on online gambling and a levy on crypto-assets, as well as common borrowing to finance ordinary Union expenditure; calls instead for Union expenditure to be prioritised, reduced where it provides no demonstrable European added value and aligned with the revenue available under the existing own resources system;
